summary: Phase 2.2 — RE-VALIDATION COMPLETE after PostHog removal + backend 302 redirect fix. 30/30 checks PASS. (1) SECURITY TOKEN: browser navigation to {BASE}/api/access/<token> lands on final URL = {BASE}/ with no trace of the token in window.location, localStorage, sessionStorage; window.posthog is undefined; ZERO network requests to *.posthog.com; dashboard-layout renders (session lien active). (2) Raw backend: GET /api/access/<token> allow_redirects=False -> 302 Location:'/' with Cache-Control:no-store and Set-Cookie access_token+refresh_token HttpOnly. (3) Persistence: F5 keeps /api/auth/me=200 MANAGER via_link, new tab same context also 200, POST /api/auth/refresh 200. (4) Identity edit: role=MANAGER, tenant_id=test-beta, via_link=true; GET /api/flows 200 (only test-beta); POST /api/flows 200; DELETE cleanup; GET /api/admin/clients 403; POST /api/auth/change-password 403. (5) Read mode: role=READ_ONLY, GET 200, POST /api/flows 403. (6) Revocation: existing session 401 on /me and /refresh; reuse of revoked token -> 302 /lien-invalide without cookies. (7) Suspension: alpha suspended -> 302 /lien-invalide?motif=suspendu without cookies. Alpha reactivated + link revoked in fixture teardown (verified). (8) Isolation: X-Act-As-Tenant:test-alpha ignored (stays test-beta). (9) No secret exposed: navixy_hash never in link session responses; Mongo tenant_access_tokens (47 docs) only carry token_hash SHA-256 hex, no 'token' or 'raw_token' fields. (10) Logs: all new '/api/access/' entries in /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log appear as '/api/access/[REDACTED]'; grep for raw pattern /api/access/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,} returns 0 matches. (11) Non-regression: SUPER_ADMIN login OK, /api/admin/overview 200; test-beta ADMIN login OK; both test-alpha and test-beta is_active=true at the end. (12) Pytest suite: 28 passed on /app/backend/tests/test_access_link.py. (13) /lien-invalide page displays neutral French text without technical terms (token/tenant/navixy/session). (14) URL emitted by super-admin endpoint uses production host format https://test-beta.logitrak.ch/api/access/<token>.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy tenant_access_tokens collection contains 47 historical docs from prior iterations (all valid SHA-256, no plaintext). Consider periodic purge of revoked+old tokens to keep the collection lean.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (30/30 browser flow, no PostHog, no token leak)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 edit access-link for test-beta then revoked it in teardown. No lingering test data. test-alpha and test-beta both is_active=true confirmed at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2.2 hardening is COMPLETE and validated end-to-end. The 302 backend exchange fully eliminates token exposure to the SPA and any client-side analytics. PostHog is entirely removed from /app/frontend/public/index.html. Log filter _AccessTokenLogFilter in server.py redacts all uvicorn access lines. Regression test file /app/backend/tests/test_access_link.py (28 tests, ~3.5s) covers create/302/cookies/me/flows/admin403/change-pwd403/refresh/read-mode/revoke/suspend/mongo-hash/audit-log/non-regression. For browser flow re-checks use /tmp/browser_check.py pattern (Playwright chromium already installed). Only remaining minor is the iteration_19 note about /api/auth/me on suspended tenant for link sessions — non-blocking.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all previously reported issues resolved. Root fix was: (a) GET /api/access/{token} now returns 302 Location:'/' with HttpOnly cookies + Cache-Control:no-store + Referrer-Policy:no-referrer so the SPA never sees the token in URL; (b) PostHog script + init block removed from public/index.html so no third-party analytics can observe URLs; (c) uvicorn access-log filter regex-redacts '/api/access/<token>' -> '/api/access/[REDACTED]'.
